# Error analysis tables (generated by `make analysis`)

Out-of-fold predictions on the training split, threshold 0.16. Recall = share of defaulters flagged; false positive rate = share of non-defaulters flagged; mean predicted vs default rate shows calibration.

## Missed defaulters

1237 of 5309 defaulters were not flagged. 90.6% of them were never late in the last 6 months (vs 34.5% of all defaulters).
